lcd_variant.note: build check only: the screen needs jumper wires from pin 18 to pin 13 (chip select) and from pin 19 to pin 31 (data/command); reset is the software reset

notes.2: PA25 reaches the on-board light sensor through J4: pull J4
notes.5: PA24 is not a GPIO in the VQFN-32 package (SysConfig lists no PA24): the press is read as analog channel 3 (ADC0.3) against 2048; PA24 also reaches the light sensor through J5: pull J5
notes.10: PA0 is also the red LED D2 through J2: pull J2 or the LED loads the I2C data line
notes.13: SWCLK: no screen select while the debugger is attached
notes.17: SWDIO: no screen reset while the debugger is attached
notes.23: PA15 carries the thermistor through J1: pull J1
notes.37: PA27 is the on-board blue LED through J13
notes.38: PA26 is the on-board red LED through J12
notes.39: PA13 is the on-board green LED through J3
notes.25: PA17 is an op-amp input: no accelerometer Z
notes.31: no pin: the screen has no data/command line
notes.34: no pin: the hello console is on pin 4 (PA8, UART TX through J16, the default routing to the probe)
